<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes/><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Get Vehicle</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
    var vin = request.pathParams.vin;
    
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_snc_vehicles_api_vehicle');
    if (gr.get('vin', vin)) {
        return {
            make: gr.getValue('make'),
            model: gr.getValue('model'),
            vin: gr.getValue('vin'),
            year: gr.getValue('year')
        };
    }
    
    response.setStatus(404);
    return { error: 'Vehicle not found' };
})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri/><produces/><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/vehicle/{vin}</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-01 06:50:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>d0a403ccc31183905c158e2599013196</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Vehicle</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Vehicles API" source="x_snc_vehicles_api">a3683ce7c38587505b4efadf050131cd</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vehicles API">a3683ce7c38587505b4efadf050131cd</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_d0a403ccc31183905c158e2599013196</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-01 06:50:32</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition/><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
